breakdown.description: The prompt treats the original x–y axes as principal directions even though a nonzero shear stress is present, so the principal stresses are not simply σ_x and 0.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly ignores the flawed assumption that principal directions remain aligned with the original axes. Instead, it explicitly applies stress transformation equations to compute principal stresses (σ1 ≈ 11.18 MPa, σ2 ≈ -1.18 MPa) and maximum in-plane shear stress, consistent with the ground truth approach. The agent does not repeat the incorrect claim that the principal stresses are simply σ_x and 0.
